candidates.exact_span: The results of all influent and effluent analyses performed pursuant to Part II(A)(1)(c) above
candidates.computation_change_reason: Applicability of influent and effluent monitoring obligations for Federal FY2025 depends on how Part II(A)(1)(c) is interpreted and which analyses fall within its scope; a different reading of that cross-referenced requirement would change which monitoring requirements are evaluated as required, not required, or unresolved.

candidates.exact_span: The monthly average water quality based effluent concentration necessary to meet the state water quality standards as developed in the approved technically based local limits.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether this language establishes enforceable numeric discharge limits versus report-only local-limit information, and whether compliance is measured on a monthly-average basis against technically based local limits, would change which limit values and comparison methods apply under Purpose A.

candidates.exact_span: All effluent monitoring conducted in accordance with Part (II) (A) (1) (c) above shall meet the Minimum Quantification Levels (MQLs) shown in MQL's at Appendix A of Part II below.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of which effluent monitoring falls under Part II(A)(1)(c), what MQL values in Appendix A require, and whether results below MQL support numeric compliance comparison would change applicable-limit determinations (A), which monitoring is subject to quantification requirements (B), and how sub-quantification or absent numeric results are classified versus missing or non-comparable evidence (C).
